'''Simon Moore Hidden Base Inserts''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Simon Moore]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls72.htm Hidden Base Inserts], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228060426/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls72.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
